title: Voice: one assistant places each sentence as you talk

chat.text: One plain voice assistant replaces the fast assistant. Each Whisper sentence lands in place in the chat bubble, and the assistant places it: same paragraph (default), its own paragraph, or its own card. Plan first at /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md, then the smallest working slice.

add.title: Plan written, slices built, in review
add.text: The plan: [voice-assistant.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md). Built in a worktree: the voice-assistant role and skill; your words now settle in place in the bubble (no draft bubble, no faded copy); the chat applies placements (same paragraph, own paragraph, own card). Headless proof passes at 400 and 1200. Next: review, merge, then Servex wiring (needs a restart).

add.title: Landed: sentences stay in place, placements are drawn
add.text: Merged (795da9d9e), review passed. Your words now grow inside the chat bubble and stay put when sent. A `{place}` line from the item tool keeps a sentence in the same paragraph, starts a new one, or makes it a titled card. Proof: `ux/Dictate/test/in-place.mjs`, fake mic, all checks pass at 400 and 1200. Plan: [voice-assistant.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md).
